## Headroom 0.9.1

Reliability release focused on Windows installs.

- **Stalled installs now fail fast instead of hanging forever.** A silence watchdog kills any installer child process that produces no output for 10 minutes (AV wedges, stuck filesystems), so the install wizard shows a classified error with a Retry path instead of a frozen progress bar. Applies to first installs, runtime upgrades, and add-on installs.
- **Install telemetry survives flaky networks.** The install-funnel beacon now retries with backoff instead of giving up after one attempt, so a relaunch that races Wi-Fi/VPN bring-up no longer loses its report.
- **Fewer spurious "could not save state" errors on Windows.** Saving app state retries briefly when an antivirus scanner or the search indexer momentarily holds the file open.
- **Better crash diagnostics on Windows** for the rare silent exit during startup: the app now probes the ML runtime in isolation and attaches the verdict to the error report.
- Fixed a false alarm in the savings plausibility check for expensive non-Anthropic model mixes.
